metadata.description: ZIVAH International S.A. - Leading exporters of premium Ecuadorian products from Ecuador to the world. Headquartered in Samborondón, Guayas with distribution office in Miami.

hero.title: The Best
hero.description: From Ecuador to the world, we connect Ecuadorian excellence with global buyers. Headquartered in Samborondón, Guayas with distribution office in Miami, we specialize in aquaculture, shrimp larvae, fruit tree cultivation, and premium Ecuadorian products.

products.title: Ecuadorian Excellence in Every Shipment
products.description: From tropical fruits to premium seafood and aquaculture larvae, we bring the best of Ecuador to tables worldwide with the highest quality and traceability.

quality.description: Our products meet the highest international quality and food safety standards. Every shipment is backed by globally recognized certifications and complete traceability processes from farm to final destination.

awards.title: International Recognition
